technical.summary: Mixed signals with strong short-term momentum (RSI-9, volume spike, supertrend) but conflicting intermediate trend structure (below key moving averages, ichimoku cloud, PSAR bearish) and overbought stochRSI suggest caution on swing entry.

fundamental.summary: DIA shows no fundamental momentum: zero insider activity, no institutional signal, no government contracts, no lobbying spend, and minimal retail interest.

sentiment.summary: Extreme fear (VIX-equivalent score 20) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but stale congressional data (916+ days old) and absent news sentiment provide no confirmation.

risk.summary: Severe macro deterioration: inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at crisis levels (335.68), strong dollar headwind, and CPI event today creates acute near-term volatility risk for broad market exposure.

debate.key_bull_argument: Volume spike (15x), RSI-9 bullish, and supertrend bullish combined with extreme fear sentiment (contrarian buy signal) and proximity to support (273.56) create a tactical short-term bounce opportunity.
debate.key_bear_argument: Macro environment is in crisis (inverted yield curve, VIX 335.68, strong dollar headwind, CPI event today), price is below all key moving averages (EMA-50, SMA-50, 200-EMA), ichimoku below cloud, PSAR bearish, stochRSI overbought, and zero fundamental support make this a high-risk entry into a deteriorating macro backdrop.

decision.entry_rationale: While volume spike and RSI-9 offer tactical bounce potential at support, macro crisis conditions (inverted yield curve, VIX 335.68, CPI event today) and price below all key moving averages create unacceptable risk-reward for swing entry.
decision.primary_risk: CPI announcement today will likely trigger acute volatility spike; broad market already in crisis mode with inverted yield curve and extreme VIX, making any bounce unsustainable.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — all agents aligned on bear case dominance
decision.portfolio_note: No sector concentration risk (0 open Broad Market positions), but portfolio drawdown at 0% means capital preservation is priority; macro environment does not justify broad market exposure at this time.
